annotation_method: Independent Poppler layout text, word geometry and visually reviewed source renders; government originals unchanged. Approximate raw PDF regions; literal selected cell/header facts only.
split_policy: Issuer and template disjoint: NCUA development; Treasury and Census holdout. No parser tuning after holdout assessment.
limits: Partial selected-cell and region truth; no complete-table topology metric.
One positive-continuation source/template; no cross-template positive generalization.
No exact cell-edge geometry accuracy claim.
Default Treasury renders failed due to unembedded Helvetica substitution; source-review includes readable isolated existing-Arial renders and failed originals.
stop_rule: Retain failing baseline; do not modify truth, selectors, thresholds or kernel to fit observed holdouts. Correct objective harness defects with regressions and preserved initial evidence; use separate development data for future parser changes.
